items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Because we got to be friendly...

ctx.x: Are you talking about Art Tatum?

I have never in my life heard nobody play... And he ruined a lot of piano players. Because he sounded like two piano players when he played. And he finally came to New York, and we talked him into coming to the Cotton Club. Because we got to be friendly... I think he was in the band when we used to go in that little alley back there in Toledo and eat...
